simulation.mechanism: From the intervention period the targeted cohort's overtime falls by 28 percent and consecutive shifts are capped at 8. The absence that follows is whatever the data-generating process produces from those inputs. No outcome is written in by hand.
simulation.seasonality: A winter multiplier is applied to every cohort for May to September, peaking at 1.30 in July. Infection-driven, so it moves absence without moving any model feature, which is why a before and after on the targeted cohort alone is misleading.
simulation.caveat: On a client's data the mechanism is unknown. The platform reports an observed difference against comparable cohorts and does not claim a cause.
